scope: Static code audit of stopped V5 direct-contact client; no new simulation. Major distinct live allocations, not a complete driver-level accounting.

buffers.name: CAD body masks
buffers.contents: bit per CAD body; shared by static and evolving Volume

buffers.name: Static material IDs
buffers.contents: original material ID per cell

buffers.name: Moving material IDs
buffers.contents: ID + 23-bit quantised alpha + moving flag

buffers.name: Static B0 packet
buffers.contents: B xyz/norm + generic J/force/heat/applied-B fields; only bias is needed here

buffers.name: Conductivity / terminal flags
buffers.contents: sigma; flags with optional low16 material-group bits

buffers.name: DC PCG work
buffers.contents: potential high, residual, search, operator product

buffers.name: Potential predictors / low words
buffers.contents: unit high, motion high, unit correction low, motion correction low
buffers.precision: 4 x f32; compensated high/low, NOT f64

buffers.name: DC output packet
buffers.contents: B xyz/norm; J xyz/divJ; force xyz/Joule density; applied B copy

buffers.name: DC reductions
buffers.contents: partial dot products / currents / power

buffers.name: Fluid mask / pressure anchors
buffers.contents: air + liquid active; solids excluded; anchor encoded

buffers.name: MAC velocity
buffers.contents: staggered ux uy uz; w reused as pressure diagonal

buffers.name: MAC scratch
buffers.contents: predicted velocities; w reused by MG

buffers.name: MAC previous
buffers.contents: accepted pre-step face velocities; energy / rollback

buffers.name: Pressure PCG work
buffers.contents: pressure potential, residual, search, operator / MG temp

buffers.name: Fluid state / output packet
buffers.contents: u xyz/speed; pressure/divergence; force; active/melt/alpha/curvature

buffers.name: Field / advector checkpoint
buffers.contents: full state rollback; same allocation reused as MAC advector checkpoint

buffers.name: Fluid reductions
buffers.contents: three vec4 partial statistics per workgroup

buffers.name: Interface A
buffers.contents: alpha; curvature; sweep indicator; divergence correction

buffers.name: Interface B
buffers.contents: ping-pong alpha / curvature / sweep workspace

buffers.name: Interface normals
buffers.contents: normal xyz + magnitude or plane intercept

buffers.name: Interface checkpoint
buffers.contents: accepted alpha packet for failed transport rollback

buffers.name: Interface reductions
buffers.contents: volume / bounds / errors / area

buffers.name: Coarse coefficient graph
buffers.contents: three neighbor coefficients + diagonal

buffers.name: Coarse corrections / work
buffers.contents: residual / correction / temp values

omitted_small: uniforms, small scalar buffers, material/component tables, Viscosity stage uniforms, phase flag/placeholders, profiler, driver allocations/caches
aliases_not_counted_twice: B0 bias references share one allocation
DC output is shared directly as fluid impressed force; no frozen-force copy
MG fine work reuses fluid work/velocity/scratch
fluid checkpoint alternates full-state backup and advector use; not two allocations
startup_only: Applied magnetic field computed once with temporary E*52 + N*128 + reductions/source buffers. Retain one N*64 result packet; drop other EM workspace. Largest temporary E*32 buffer.
CPU: time/pulse schedule and energy accumulation f64; main GPU arithmetic f32. Readback scalars/control flags synchronize iterated solves.
